tara_am: FYI - Faraday Labs (FA-21) flagged INV-2026-07. They see a duplicate reserved commit line around a canary cutover window. Posting invoice snippet they attached.

tara_am: Invoice excerpt:
```
INV-2026-07 | FA-21 | Reserved Commit (monthly) | $8,400.00
INV-2026-07 | FA-21-canary | Reserved Commit (alloc 30%) | $2,520.00
INV-2026-07 | FA-21-prod   | Reserved Commit (alloc 70%) | $5,880.00
INV-2026-07 | FA-21-canary | Reserved Commit (alloc 30%) | $2,520.00  <-- duplicate line
```

kevin_ops: Quick check of allocator logs. Looks like a tag propagation retry during canary rollout duplicated the tagset for a 12m window. Tokens consumed remain within the single monthly commit.

kevin_ops: Short log snippet: `2026-07-10T14:58Z canary:tag apply; 2026-07-10T15:01Z canary:tag retry -> duplicate tagset recorded`

tara_am: Customer wants corrected invoice + explanation. What's our suggested credit?

oliver_fin: Remove duplicate reserved line = -$2,520. SLA credit: their plan gives 5% per qualifying incident -> 5% of $8,400 = -$420. Offer small goodwill -$100. Provisional total = -$3,040. I can approve up to $3,100 provisional. Open FIN-8201 to track.

mina_infra: I'll open INFRA-56111 to patch tag retrier dedupe and run a backfill for 2026-07-10. ETA 36h. Backfill will regenerate allocation lines and confirm duplicate removal.

billing-bot: Metering alert: `duplicate-reserved-allocation` FA-21 2026-07-10T15:01Z. Candidate duplicate flagged.

tara_am: Draft customer note: "Thanks for flagging. We found a tagging retry during your canary rollout that caused a duplicate reserved allocation line. We've applied a provisional $3,040 credit and will issue a corrected invoice after we backfill meter records. This is a one-time correction and will not change your commit profile. ETA: 48 business hours." OK to send?

oliver_fin: Send it. Finance will finalize after INFRA-56111 backfill and AM confirmation.

mina_infra: INFRA-56111 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-56111. Will post backfill completion here.

billing-bot: FIN action logged: FIN-8201 provisional_credit=3040 recipient=FA-21 timestamp=2065432350

tara_am: Customer acknowledged provisional note. Closing loop after backfill. :white_check_mark:
